title: 没有运单的仓库
objective: 从仓库档案找出尚无运单记录的仓库。
statement: 找出 warehouses 中一张运单也没有的仓库。运单只要登记在 shipments 里就算，已取消的也算。依次输出 warehouse_id（仓库编号）、warehouse_name（仓库名称），每仓一行，行顺序不限。全部仓库都有运单时返回零行。
knowledge: 用 warehouses LEFT JOIN shipments 按仓库编号配对。匹配到几张运单就生成几行；一张都没有的仓库也会有一行，右表列填成 NULL。
shipments.id 是运单主键，实际登记的运单都有编号。用 WHERE s.id IS NULL 找没连上的行。不能用 s.delivered_at 判断，有运单但未签收时它也可能是 NULL。
若把 s.id IS NULL 放到 ON 里，任何真实运单都无法匹配，LEFT JOIN 会把所有仓库都保留下来。
starterSql: -- 找出从未产生运单的仓库。

hints.text: 从仓库档案查运单。区分根本没有运单，与有运单但尚未签收。
LEFT JOIN 的 ON 用发运仓编号配对；配对后用 WHERE 检查运单主键 IS NULL。
SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM warehouses AS w LEFT JOIN shipments AS s ON ____ WHERE ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM warehouses AS w LEFT JOIN shipments AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.id IS NULL;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 蜀山仓没有任何运单能够配上，左连接为它保留一行且 s.id 为 NULL。只筛这样补出来的行，北辰仓即使有运单没签收，也不会被列入。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM warehouses AS w JOIN shipments AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.id IS NULL;
SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM warehouses AS w LEFT JOIN shipments AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id AND s.id IS NULL;
SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM warehouses AS w LEFT JOIN shipments AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id;
SELECT w.id AS warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name FROM warehouses AS w LEFT JOIN shipments AS s ON s.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE s.delivered_at IS NULL;
